repository.description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows

contributorEndpoint.attribution_note: GitHub contributors endpoint attributes contributors from repository commits, returns ranked/paginated entries, and may omit users who hide their contribution graph; anon=1 includes anonymous commit authors. These are commit-attributed contributors, not all users who interacted with the repository.

prSample.sample_definition: The 100 most recently updated closed pull requests returned by GitHub REST API /repos/boykopovar/AnyPS5/pulls?state=closed&per_page=100&sort=updated&direction=desc. This is a bounded sample, not a random or complete estimate of current merge speed.
prSample.merge_duration_definition: Elapsed hours from pull request created_at to merged_at; only merged pull requests in the 100-record sample are included.

merge_duration_hours.quantile_method: Nearest-rank, zero-based index floor(n*p); reported prose rounds these values.

prSample.automation_caveat: The complete closed-PR listing contains 42 records with the open PR limit label and none merged. The workflow documents automatic closure when an author exceeds the open-PR limit, explicitly saying this is not a judgment of change quality. The stale-conflict automation labels conflicts after inactivity and does not close them.

graphql_probe.conclusion: GraphQL reports the count but returns empty stargazer edges for all three connection probes; no first/last event date is available to this account.

caveats: Repository creation time comes from GitHub repository metadata. The earliest reachable commit is a separate timestamp and may predate repository creation.
Star history uses the stargazers endpoint's starred_at timestamps and covers currently returned stargazers; deleted accounts and stars removed before collection are not represented.
GitHub restricted the stargazers listing endpoint to repository admins and collaborators in July 2026. This account received HTTP 404, so historical star dates are unavailable in this collection.
The watchers field is GitHub subscribers_count (people watching notifications). The API's watchers_count mirrors stargazers_count and is not presented as notification watchers.
Repository metadata's open_issues_count includes open pull requests; open_issues_only is the separate GitHub issue-search total.

GitHub contributors endpoint attributes contributors from repository commits, returns ranked/paginated entries, and may omit users who hide their contribution graph; anon=1 includes anonymous commit authors. These are commit-attributed contributors, not all users who interacted with the repository.
Commit activity counts default-branch commits using author dates. It measures repository history, not unique human contributions or all branches.
Language values are GitHub Linguist byte counts, not line counts.
